definitions.first_content_ms: Host stream first nonempty JSON content after model request start; not first spoken word or RPC response arrival.
definitions.decode_tokens_per_second: Ollama eval_count divided by eval_duration; includes complete JSON output tokens.
definitions.rpc_ms: Board monotonic request-to-complete-response; includes LAN, admission, inference and transfer.
definitions.rpc_real_time_factor: Complete TTS RPC seconds divided by returned PCM seconds; includes transfer/admission overhead, not isolated GPU kernel time.
definitions.gpu_memory: 1-second nvidia-smi device samples; total device usage includes desktop and other processes, not isolated model allocation or guaranteed peak.
definitions.warm_state: Both original models already resident; no cold start/unload performed. Prefix cache was retained as production runtime normally uses it.
definitions.statistics: Six public input cases each; median/range are descriptive, P95 nearest rank with small N equals the maximum. No accuracy or stability guarantee.
definitions.scope_exclusions: No microphone ASR, real conversation context/memory, playback/acoustic first sound, motion, or visual artifact stability acceptance in these synthetic model requests.
